verdict.rationale: Only community comments support this story: they say Dagster 'figured out how to do development branches' and was designed for laptop-to-prod local development, with testability that separates business logic from environmental concerns. No first-party docs in the pack describe an isolated sandbox or branch environment that keeps tests away from production data. The asset-check docs cover data-quality tests, not environment isolation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of sandbox or branch deployments, explicit isolation of production data and credentials, any agent-facing sandbox workflow, and hands-on corroboration.
